model:
tff('declare_$i1',type,'fmb_$i_1':$i).
tff('declare_$i2',type,'fmb_$i_2':$i).
tff('declare_$i3',type,'fmb_$i_3':$i).
tff('declare_$i4',type,'fmb_$i_4':$i).
tff('finite_domain_$i',axiom,
      ! [X:$i] : (
         X = 'fmb_$i_1' | X = 'fmb_$i_2' | X = 'fmb_$i_3' | X = 'fmb_$i_4'
      ) ).

tff('distinct_domain_$i',axiom,
         'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_2' & 'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_3' & 'fmb_$i_1' != 'fmb_$i_4' & 'fmb_$i_2' != 'fmb_$i_3' & 'fmb_$i_2' != 'fmb_$i_4' & 
         'fmb_$i_3' != 'fmb_$i_4'
).

tff(declare_v01,type,v01:$i).
tff(v01_definition,axiom,v01 = 'fmb_$i_1').
tff(declare_v00,type,v00:$i).
tff(v00_definition,axiom,v00 = 'fmb_$i_2').
tff(declare_v10,type,v10:$i).
tff(v10_definition,axiom,v10 = 'fmb_$i_3').
tff(declare_v11,type,v11:$i).
tff(v11_definition,axiom,v11 = 'fmb_$i_4').
tff(declare_a,type,a: ($i) > $o).
tff(predicate_a,axiom,
           ~a('fmb_$i_1')
         & a('fmb_$i_2')
         & ~a('fmb_$i_3')
         & ~a('fmb_$i_4')

).

tff(declare_inO1,type,inO1: ($i) > $o).
tff(predicate_inO1,axiom,
           inO1('fmb_$i_1')
         & inO1('fmb_$i_2')
         & inO1('fmb_$i_3')
         & inO1('fmb_$i_4')

).
